scenario.zh: 租户需要在月初支付全额租金,但现金流紧张。通过分期支付和积分奖励,租户可以按自己的节奏管理租金成本。
scenario.en: A tenant faces tight cash flow at month-end but rent is due on the 1st. Flexible installments and earning rewards on each payment help spread costs.

instruction.zh: 看看分期支付如何适应不同的租金管理需求
instruction.en: See how installments fit different rent payment needs

label.zh: 首次入住 - 降低初期成本

output.zh: 用分期支付代替全额押金,按月累积积分
output.en: Replace lump-sum deposit with installments, accumulate rewards monthly

input.zh: 月租2000元 + 押金2000元 = 首月需4000元
input.en: Monthly rent 2000 SGD + deposit 2000 SGD = 4000 SGD upfront

output.zh: 月租分2期 (1000+1000) + 积分可用于未来支付
output.en: Rent split into 2 installments (1000+1000) + rewards apply to future payments

label.zh: 月中困难 - 推迟部分租金

output.zh: 将本月租金分期至下月,并在每笔付款中赚取里程积分
output.en: Spread this month's rent across next month, earn miles on each installment

input.zh: 1月1日: 一次性支付2000元租金
input.en: Jan 1: Pay full 2000 SGD rent in one go

output.zh: 1月10日: 支付1200元 (赚30积分); 1月20日: 支付800元 (赚20积分)
output.en: Jan 10: Pay 1200 SGD (earn 30 miles); Jan 20: Pay 800 SGD (earn 20 miles)

detail.zh: 按现金流灵活选择日期,积分立即生效
detail.en: Pick date to match cash flow; rewards credit immediately

detail.zh: 剩余金额加积分,完成月度承诺
detail.en: Remaining balance plus rewards fulfill monthly commitment

label.zh: 长期管理 - 持续积累奖励

output.zh: 每次分期支付都赚积分,用于抵扣未来租金或其他费用
output.en: Earn rewards on every installment, redeem toward future rent or fees

input.zh: 每月分2次支付租金2000元,每笔支付赚25-50积分,取决于金额
input.en: Each month: 2 installments of 2000 SGD total; earn 25–50 miles per payment based on amount

output.zh: 6个月累计300-600积分 → 可抵扣下月租金、水电费或搬迁费用
output.en: 6 months = 300–600 miles total → redeem for next month's rent, utilities, or moving costs

detail.zh: 每笔分期付款按比例赚取,无需额外步骤
detail.en: Proportional to each installment; no extra steps required

detail.zh: 积分可立即用于当月或转移到未来月份
detail.en: Use immediately this month or roll forward anytime

instruction.zh: 灵活组织你的支付时间表,适应现金流
instruction.en: Organize your payment timeline to fit cash flow

label.zh: 均等分期 - 简单可预测

output.zh: 租金平均分成若干相等部分,每期日期固定
output.en: Rent split into equal parts on fixed dates each month

label.zh: 自定义分期 - 按需调整

output.zh: 根据现金流灵活设定分期金额和日期,每月不同
output.en: Set different amounts and dates each month to match your income

takeaway.zh: 分期支付和积分奖励降低了入住成本,让租户按自己的节奏管理现金流。具体的奖励兑现政策、最低分期金额和合作物业列表需在平台上验证。
takeaway.en: Installments and rewards lower entry costs and align with tenant cash flow. Verify reward redemption rules, minimum splits, and participating properties on the platform.
